title.en: An Act to Amend Section Two Hundred and Six of the Administrative Code, Authorizing the Transfer of Justices of the Peace From One Municipality to Another.

text.en:
Section two hundred and six of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 206. Tenure of office-transfer from one municipality to another.-A justice of the peace having the
requisite legal qualifications shall hold office during good behavior unless his office be lawfully abolished or
merged in the jurisdiction of some other justice: Provided, That in case the pubic interest requires it, a justice
of the peace of one municipality may be transferred to another."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 5, 1918.
